title: First American Home Warranty Names Jason Gritters Chief Revenue Officer
summary: First American Home Warranty Names Jason Gritters Chief Revenue Officer
body_markdown:
Experienced home warranty and growth operator to lead the company’s real estate business line, corporate development function, and emerging growth initiatives


---


August 24, 2026, Santa Rosa, Calif.


[First American Home Warranty](https://homewarranty.firstam.com/) **, a subsidiary of First American Financial Corporation and one of the nation’s leading home warranty companies, today announced** that Jason Gritters has joined the company as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO).


In this newly created executive role, Gritters will lead First American Home Warranty’s real estate line of business and corporate development function, while helping identify and advance new revenue opportunities that complement the company’s core home warranty business. His responsibilities include driving alignment and growth across the company’s real estate sales organization, strengthening strategic partnerships and distribution opportunities, and advancing initiatives designed to create additional value for customers, partners and the company.


“Jason brings a unique combination of deep home warranty experience, home services industry expertise and a strong track record of developing offerings and executing growth strategies,” said Matt Wendl, CEO of First American Home Warranty. “As we continue to strengthen our core business and pursue new opportunities for growth, Jason will play an important role in bringing greater alignment across our real estate organization, corporate development efforts and emerging revenue initiatives. His strategic perspective, industry relationships and ability to translate opportunities into action will help us build on First American Home Warranty’s strong foundation and position the company for continued long-term growth.”


Gritters brings more than 10 years of leadership experience across the home warranty and home services industries. He most recently served as vice president of product and corporate development at 2-10 Home Buyers Warranty, where his responsibilities included leadership of the real estate business channel, product, sales operations, enterprise strategy and growth initiatives and strategic partnerships. Gritters' experience also includes developing go-to-market programs, brokerage partnerships, sales operations, customer relationship management strategies and acquisition marketing programs serving both real estate professionals and homeowners.


Earlier in his career, Gritters held leadership roles across finance, product management and business operations and worked in private equity, where he supported portfolio companies in accelerating growth. This broad experience across strategy, operations, product development and investment provides a strong foundation for his expanded responsibilities at First American Home Warranty.


Gritters earned his Bachelor of Science in Finance from Colorado State University and his Master of Business Administration from the University of Denver. ****


### **About First American Home Warranty**


Established in 1984, First American Home Warranty has provided quality protection for homeowners across the nation, through more than 10 million home warranties, for more than 40 years. Today, First American's home warranty products continue to offer homeowners important coverage to protect their budgets from unexpected costs for repairing or replacing home systems and appliances. For more information, visit[homewarranty.firstam.com](https://homewarranty.firstam.com/) . ****


### **About First American**


**First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF)** is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. With its combination of financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, innovative proprietary technologies, and unmatched data assets, the company is leading the digital transformation of its industry. First American also provides data products to the title industry and other third parties; valuation products and services; mortgage subservicing; home warranty products; banking, trust and wealth management services; and other related products and services. With total revenue of $7.5 billion in 2025, the company offers its products and services directly and through its agents throughout the United States and abroad. In 2026, First American was named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for the eleventh consecutive year. More information about the company can be found at[www.firstam.com](http://www.firstam.com/) .
